next_minimal_candidate.scope: Store same-invocation canonical NetworkGrantView decode reuse
next_minimal_candidate.reason: Store signed(view) canonical-decodes exact claims for envelope metadata, discards that decoded value, then snapshot.verify_member or verify_network_grant canonical-decodes the same immutable bytes again. Identity private_service already reuses its existing canonical candidate, but Store's independent path still repeats it.
next_minimal_candidate.required_invariants: Retain base64/canonical and metadata-before-signature order, active member/role checks, every original signature and full fresh snapshot/currentness check. No authorization, deadline, row or time cache.
next_minimal_candidate.claim_limit: The phase's serde samples justify investigating the visible duplicate, but no call graph identifies its measured share and no capacity improvement is established.

limits: No call graph, SQL timing, mutex wait, DB admission wait or per-open_stream cost was collected. User-space sampled CPU percentages are not elapsed wall-clock percentages.
after-all-controls-recorded may include scheduler handoff, opening, continued currentness, error handling and teardown. It is not a pure opening phase or a per-query measurement.

Early target work can precede perf attachment, and the first sample occurs later than target launch. Phase counts describe captured samples only; absence of a sample does not establish absence of work.
640 readiness records do not prove 1000 simultaneously live targets, the original two-second hold, complete durable accounting or three successful waves.
One hosted process does not qualify 100 physical nodes, independent relay/management capacity, all queue bounds or cross-day soak. AC68 remains failed.

The complete original receipt and all 256 clock anchors remain in the officially hashed archive; this focused document retains their SHA256, complete file manifest, exact producer commands and independently checked summaries.
